body:
Independent source-eligibility review under the common rule `retained-mapped-land-named-physical-envelope-exact-addition-v1`.

**PASS for conditional exact construction:** `12c9ec981349…` → Banks Island Lowland; `add031b719535…` and `17bb5b7f043b…` → Foxe Basin Plain. Each complete ID and immutable source/proposal pins is in the typed receipt below. These are new candidate-specific applications of one reusable rule, not transferred approval from #1295 or #1487.

**FAIL / unchanged:** `52452c5923a0…`, `2aca267603c8…`, `265c983a6123…`, `54dc96cd3d0e…`; literal loss or gain mismatch remains. A source-envelope match alone is insufficient.

All3 original native records and decoded pointsets independently authenticate; whole mapped-land support equals the candidate coordinate ring and all retained conflicting/reconstruction/outside pointsets are empty. Current source editions, targets, hierarchy and entire active geography remain byte-identical to the independently reviewed complete r12 source context. No GIS was rerun. Water/ice/date/legal/history uncertainty remains explicit. Combined same-target union and all final delivery gates still need actual implementation proof.

Later candidates of this same source/target class may use this rule with complete authenticated frozen premises; failed/missing/stale/conflicting evidence remains an exception. This is not blanket approval of other sources or administrative boundaries.

**Installed-baseline correction:** The tracked part29 (`077e3b…`) is historical; installed v8 consumes the accepted full body (`c341149…`,12,932,407bytes) preserving #1295’s Quebec/Newfoundland additions. I authenticated the public retained gzip and complete decoded body, compared every part29 feature, and found exactly those two differences. Both complete changed geometries are envelope-disjoint from every Arctic candidate; the two Arctic targets and all other features are identical. Thus the three eligibility PASS decisions remain valid, but the implementation must use installed v8 as its before-image and preserve both previous repairs. No new GIS run or current-world equivalence claim based solely on tracked077.
